sources.title: Check if you need an environmental permit
sources.verified_claim: Activities that can pollute, increase flood risk, affect land drainage or water resources may require permits or licences; exact requirement depends on the activity.

sources.title: Apply for an environmental permit
sources.verified_claim: Environmental permits have application, charging and operating requirements; submitting or being able to submit an application is not permit approval.

sources.title: Get advice before you apply for an environmental permit
sources.verified_claim: Pre-application advice can identify permit type, forms and assessments but the Environment Agency explicitly does not confirm that a proposal is suitable or likely to be approved.

sources.title: Discharges to surface water and groundwater environmental permits
sources.verified_claim: Liquid-effluent or wastewater discharges may require standard-rules or bespoke permits with operator, treatment and monitoring conditions.

sources.title: Flood risk activities environmental permits
sources.verified_claim: Certain works affecting main rivers, flood defences or floodplain assets require flood-risk activity permits and supporting method/risk information; exact location controls applicability.

sources.title: Check if you need a licence to abstract water
sources.verified_claim: Surface-water or groundwater abstraction may require a licence, with exemptions and regulatory-position statements; candidate abstraction is not assumed.

sources.title: Legal operator and competence requirements environmental permits
sources.verified_claim: Permits can only be issued or transferred to qualifying legal operators with required competence; operator identity is activity-specific.

sources.title: Assessing and scoring environmental permit and licence compliance
sources.verified_claim: The Environment Agency publishes compliance-assessment principles for permits and licences including flood-risk and water-discharge activities; general compliance methodology is not a candidate permit record.
